title-screen.alt: The title screen on a near-black background with faint blue stars. "Pattern Break" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a row of small LED segments shading from green to red. Below it, a menu in small pixel type: "Play" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Practice" with "The_Epic_Chip", "Difficulty" with "Normal", and "Jukebox", in grey. Under the menu, "Music: The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain.", and at the bottom two lines of help: "Up and down choose. Left and right change. Enter selects." and "In play: arrows or WASD fly, Esc pauses."
title-screen.caption: The title menu. Not used in the README.

gameplay.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern. Bands of dark grey stone run along the top and bottom edges. Columns of small square LED segments hang from the top stone, lit green to yellow, and rise from the bottom stone, green through yellow to orange, the floor taller than the ceiling. Near the left, a few ceiling columns have nothing lit. A small cyan ship with a magenta engine flame flies on the left through the dark passage between them, with faint blue stars behind.
gameplay.caption: Pattern Break at 21.5 seconds into the test song on normal, with the ship flown by the autopilot.

gameplay-clip.alt: Four seconds of play in an LED cavern. Dark grey stone runs along the top and bottom edges, and columns of square LED segments on it, lit green to orange, scroll from right to left, one column per row of the song, rising and falling with the music. A small cyan ship with a flickering engine flame steers through the dark passage between them, and faint blue stars drift more slowly behind.
gameplay-clip.caption: Four seconds of the test song on normal, flown by the autopilot through the sim.
